n-pumpfun-card-gacha.summary: Coins named for, or describing, Pump.fun's trading-card gacha with Collector Crypt. Posts of 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20 say Pump.fun put Collector Crypt card packs (gacha) and a card marketplace into its app (e4:0): the earliest such posts in the sample are from 2026-10-19 19:04 to 19:13 UTC; a post from the CoinGecko account on 2026-10-20 (07:50 UTC) says $CARDS was up 19% that day following Pump.fun's integration of Collector Crypt's gacha, and a post of 2026-10-20 (04:59 UTC) says about $2M of gacha packs had been opened in the Pump.fun app since its launch the day before, about 20% of Collector Crypt's gacha spend that day. A recap post says the launch "spawned $COLLECTOOOR to $1m and pumped the $pokemon coin launched" (e3:1). Five coins on covered launchpads carry the theme: two coins named the collectooor (COLLECTOOOR, pump.fun; pools created 2026-10-19 18:59 UTC and 2026-10-20 02:52 UTC), two named Pokémon (pump.fun, pool created 2026-10-20 00:01 UTC; MeteoraDBC, pool created 2026-10-20 10:02 UTC) and filled.cards (FILLED, pump.fun; pool created 2026-10-02, well before the integration), whose metadata reads "Limit orders and trading terminal for Cards. Powered by @Collector_Crypt". Only FILLED has a description; the other four have empty metadata, so their names and the posts carry the link. None of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Pump.fun or Collector Crypt, and most posts about them are call-group promotion. Measured: five coins across all their pools.

summaries.n-perpetual-futures: Coins whose metadata describes perpetual-futures trading. Papertrade's site (papertrade.xyz, e1:0) says "1000x leverage, 0 market impact, 100% user owned, fully onchain on hyperliquid", and @papertrade_xyz posted that trading was expected to start at 14:00 UTC on 2026-10-10. Three coins named Paper (Papertrade) copy its tagline: a new Clanker contract on Base (pool created 2026-10-19 12:39 UTC) that carries 99.5% of the narrative's volume, and the two Clanker contracts that carried it a day earlier (Base, pool created 2026-10-18, and Robinhood Chain, pool created 2026-10-19), which traded about $541 and $214 in the 24h chart window after tens of millions the day before. Two older Paper contracts (Base and Robinhood Chain, pools created 2026-10-17) left on 2026-10-20 after their 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000. The sources seen never name any of these contracts. Posts of 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-19 say PAPER is trading as a pre-launch perpetual on Hyperliquid listed by Paragon and that the token cannot yet be moved between wallets, and a post of 2026-10-20 says Papertrade then made PAPER non-transferable and Paragon shut the perp (e1:5; not verified), so affiliation of the on-chain Paper copies with Papertrade is not verified. EmpireX (EMPIREX, Pons, Robinhood Chain) says it is a perpetual trading hub powered by Hyperliquid, and @HyperEmpireX introduced it on 2026-10-16. Purps (PURPS, Meteora DBC) says it launches perp-backed tokens. Aloooong (pump.fun) calls itself the "First 10x PUMP long perpetual meme". These are the projects' and traders' own claims: revenue, leverage, payouts and affiliation among the coins are not verified. Measured: six coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI; a 2026-10-15 post reports that the task force is due to hold its first meeting (e1:4). Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, and three BNB Chain coins on Flap named TeslaSI ("Tesla Super Intelligence", pool created 2026-10-11; a second whose Chinese metadata says it follows the SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename; and, since 2026-10-20, テスラSI, pool created 2026-10-19 02:34 UTC, whose Japanese metadata says Musk announced SpaceXAI becomes SpaceXSI and describes a 3% trade tax with 30% paid as on-chain dividends to holders). The Tetsuo Super Intelligence coin on pump.fun (TSI, Solana) joined on 2026-10-18 with a pool 4.6 hours old at discovery: traders' posts call TSI "another SI coin" and one says Elon Musk posted about it (e1:1), which is unverified. Its Clanker twin on Robinhood Chain left on 2026-10-20 after 24h pool volume of $277 and then $0. SPACEXSI and Ollie (pump.fun) left on 2026-10-17, and SIGF (pump.fun) and SuperHooks (Pons) on 2026-10-18, after their 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000.
